purpose: Observe one already-started run until a completion, failure, or explicitly unknown terminal state is supported by events.
trigger: Use after one execution event is correlated and no second run may start.

inputs.name: execution_event
inputs.description: Unique run ID, launch time, script hash, and session/document binding.

inputs.name: status_observation_source
inputs.description: Allowed UI/log/report source and observation timestamps.

inputs.name: timeout_policy
inputs.description: Bounded wait, polling interval, and unknown-state rule.

preconditions: Exactly one run event is known and the observation source is available.
Timeout and unknown handling are declared before waiting.

outputs.name: terminal_state
outputs.description: Completed, failed, or unknown state with event evidence and run ID.

postconditions: Return a state supported by ordered observations, or unknown when timeout/trace cannot prove completion.
No execution command is issued while waiting.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. Waiting does not promote a runtime report to independent geometry or persistence evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Observation cannot be tied to one run.
failure_modes.detection: Multiple events match or run ID is absent.
failure_modes.safe_state: No retry or save is allowed.

failure_modes.condition: Bounded wait expires without a terminal event.
failure_modes.detection: Timeout policy expires or source stops changing.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not rerun or save the current design.

recovery.action: Preserve trace and start new diagnosis only after caller decides.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Return a state supported by ordered observations, or unknown when timeout/trace cannot prove completion.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
